def paint(n: int, ops: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    flag = 1 << 30
    mask = flag - 1

    events = []
    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
        value = op[3] if op[0] == 1 else flag
        events.append((op[1], i, value))
        events.append((op[2] + 1, i, 0))

    events.sort()

    size = 1
    while size < len(ops):
        size <<= 1

    tree = [0] * (2 * size)
    counts = {}
    previous = 1

    for position, index, value in events:
        colour = tree[1] & mask
        if colour and position > previous:
            counts[colour] = counts.get(colour, 0) + position - previous

        previous = position
        node = size + index
        tree[node] = value
        node >>= 1

        while node:
            left = tree[node << 1]
            right = tree[node << 1 | 1]

            if right & flag:
                tree[node] = right
            else:
                tree[node] = (left & flag) | max(left & mask, right)

            node >>= 1

    return [[colour, counts[colour]] for colour in sorted(counts)]
